rendering.identifier: configured lowercase prefix plus the first 8 lowercase hex characters of the field HMAC
rendering.integer: inclusive minimum plus the unsigned field HMAC modulo the configured span
rendering.port: 20000 plus the unsigned field HMAC modulo 30000

isolation_rules: The private run secret is never written into a fixture, prompt, trace, or public receipt.
Each task and randomized field has a distinct HMAC domain.
Only rendered ordinary names, values, and a one-way task-seed commitment may be public.
Clean reruns use a new private run secret and a new run nonce.
